name: Trigger 1
description: When PT share of passenger-kilometres exceeds 0.34 PKM share (0-1) for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 8-year lead time.

name: Trigger 2
description: When Car share of passenger-kilometres is at or below 0.479 PKM share (0-1) for 2 consecutive years, decide to build; open after a 4-year lead time.
